description: This file implements the HostMappingRules class, which manages hostname mapping and exclusion rules, including functions to rewrite host URLs based on pattern matching rules.

classes.name: HostMappingRules
classes.description: Manages hostname mapping and exclusion rules, providing functions to add rules, rewrite URLs, and apply pattern-based hostname transformations.

classes.name: HostMappingRules::MapRule
classes.description: Represents a hostname mapping rule with a pattern, replacement hostname, and optional port.

classes.name: HostMappingRules::RewriteResult
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the result of a URL rewrite attempt.

methods.name: RewriteHost
methods.description: Attempts to rewrite the host and port of a given HostPortPair based on matching rules.

methods.name: RewriteUrl
methods.description: Rewrites the URL's host and port according to the defined rules, returning the result status.

methods.name: AddRuleFromString
methods.description: Parses a rule string to add either a mapping or exclusion rule.

methods.name: SetRulesFromString
methods.description: Sets multiple rules from a comma-separated string, clearing existing rules.
